# JSON dependency

`json.hpp`: nlohmann/json v3.11.3, the original single-header file.

Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3

Downloaded from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/v3.11.3/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

The MIT license is included in `LICENSE.nlohmann-json` and the library header.
The library file is unmodified. CMake downloads nothing during the build.
